current.summary: QQQM is at near all-time highs after a strong 45% 1-year run, sitting just 0.1% below its 52-week peak with solid momentum above its 200-day moving average. Despite the Fear & Greed index sitting in fear territory at 38, price action remains constructive, suggesting institutional buyers are still engaged. For a long-term accumulator not yet holding this ETF, this is a reasonable entry point on a normal DCA basis — not a moment to chase aggressively, but not one to avoid either.
current.this_month: Contribute your normal monthly DCA amount — no more, no less. The ETF is effectively at all-time highs, so there is no tactical reason to add extra, but the Fear & Greed reading at 38 means sentiment is not euphoric, which reduces the risk of buying into a crowded peak. Avoid any lump-sum additions this month; patience and consistency are the edge here.
current.long_term_thesis: QQQM provides cost-efficient, liquid exposure to the 100 largest non-financial NASDAQ companies, capturing secular growth trends in technology, AI, semiconductors, and consumer internet at a low 0.15% expense ratio. As the smaller share-class sibling of QQQ designed specifically for long-term retail accumulators, it is a foundational growth engine for any long-horizon portfolio.
current.risks: High concentration risk is the primary concern — the top 10 holdings (Apple, Microsoft, NVIDIA, Amazon, Meta, etc.) represent roughly 50%+ of the index, meaning a rotation out of mega-cap tech or a valuation reset in AI-linked names could produce drawdowns of 30–50%, as seen in 2022. Investors must have the conviction and time horizon to hold through those periods.
current.add_rationale: QQQM is not currently in the portfolio, and for a long-term growth-oriented investor it is a high-conviction core holding worth initiating. Begin with a normal first monthly contribution to establish the position, then commit to consistent monthly DCA going forward. Do not wait for a pullback that may not come — starting the habit of accumulation is more important than timing the entry perfectly.
